title: Hermit Thrush Cabin

services.name: The Cabin
services.desc: Hermit Thrush Cabin is nestled in the subalpine forest at 1,920 m (6,300 ft) above sea level above Valemount, BC, Canada. The seven-sided log cabin is well equipped to provide comfort in any mountain weather. The owners not only designed and hand-built the hut, but also sawed the local cedar logs. The unusual shape maximises natural light and takes full advantage of the spectacular view of nearby McKirdy Mountain. The cabin is off-grid, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the rhythm of the wilderness. A mossy stream just below the cabin leads to a small mountain lake; those up to braving mountain water temperatures can take a refreshing dip. The old rockslide east of the cabin
